function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live weather data at the moment. If you’d like, I can show you how to check the current temperature using a reliable weather website or app.

So we can respond with approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But maybe we can use some API? No tool defined. So we should respond that I can't fetch real-time data. Or we could give a placeholder. According to policy, we cannot hallucinate. So we should say we don't have real-time capability.
